name: ownership
description: Who a corpus subject belongs to, which decides the denominator it counts toward. Previously declared only in the deployment's corpus-config and in the harness projection, never in the contract.
note: 'owned' = the deploying org's own backlog, the canonical distinct-exposure denominator. 'upstream' = community code relied on, reported as an adjacent supply-chain line and never folded into owned. 'external-bu' = engagements performed for another business unit, work-performed only. 'harness-qa' = harness self-measurement, excluded from every metrics lens and never a readable scope.
